tools.description: Check that this app is connected to the Pine Hollow office, and confirm which office person it is connected as.

tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Search the Pine Hollow office wiki: how camp runs, who owns what, business rules, regulations, vendors, hiring. Then read a page in full with read_wiki_page.
